{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the unique values in 'channel' to verify number of channels
channels = data['channel'].unique()
print(f"Unique channels: {channels}")

# Check the distribution of revenue values
print(f"\nRevenue values (top 10):\n{data['revenue'].value_counts().head(10)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = data[data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age (to confirm sentinel)
age_neg1_count = (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age = -1: {age_neg1_count}")"}
